```{r, eval = FALSE}
getwd()
setwd("~/collaborations/temp")
# mdoel fit function
data = read_csv("Data/clean_all_studies_DSMM_2024Feb.csv")
outcome = c("MEM", "LAN", "EXF")
n_iter = 4000

study_exclude = "A4"

# SMM

file_name_smm = paste0("NEW_ALL_", outcome, "_smm", "_iter", n_iter, ".rds")

smm_exist = file.exists(file.path("objects", "overall", file_name_smm))

if (smm_exist){
  
  # if the file exists, readin the file
  smm_fit = readRDS(paste0("objects/overall/", file_name_smm))
  
} else {
  
  # otherwise, fit the model
  
  # data
  dat_smm = subset(data, !Study %in% study_exclude)
  dat_smm = subset(dat_smm, AD_conv == 1)
  dat_smm = dat_smm[order(dat_smm$Study, dat_smm$subj_id, dat_smm$Age), ]
  
  prior_spec <- prior(normal(0, 1), nlpar = "theta0") + 
    prior(normal(0, 1), nlpar = "theta1") + 
    prior(normal(0, 1), nlpar = "tau")
  
  set.seed(2024)
  
  smm_fit <- brm(bf( eval(parse(text = paste0(outcome, " ~ theta0 - theta1/( 1 + exp( tau - time_to_AD ) )"))) , 
                     theta0 ~ 1 + (1||Study/subj_id),
                     theta1 ~ 1 + (1||Study/subj_id),
                     tau ~ 1 + (1||Study/subj_id),
                     nl = TRUE),
                 data = dat_smm, 
                 prior = prior_spec,
                 chain = 1,
                 thin = 5,
                 iter = n_iter,
                 save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
                 # , silent = 2, refresh = 0
  )
  
  saveRDS(smm_fit, paste0("objects/overall/ALL_", outcome, "_smm_iter", n_iter, ".rds"))
  
}

Sys.time()
# DSMM 
# Data for DSMM model
dat_dsmm = subset(data, !Study %in% study_exclude)
dat_dsmm = subset(dat_dsmm,  I_MCI == 1 | I_AD == 1)
dat_dsmm = dat_dsmm[order(dat_dsmm$Study, dat_dsmm$subj_id, dat_dsmm$Age), ]

# remove subjects with reverted diagnoses from AD to an earlier stage
dat_dsmm = subset(dat_dsmm, retro_AD2MCI == 0 & retro_AD2NC == 0 )

# derive the new time variable: time to `event`
dat_dsmm$t_event = dat_dsmm$time_to_AD
## (only) MCI convertors (time to MCI conv)
dat_dsmm$t_event[dat_dsmm$MCI_conv == 1] = dat_dsmm$time_to_MCI[dat_dsmm$MCI_conv == 1]
## only-AD convertors
dat_dsmm$t_event[dat_dsmm$AD_conv == 1] = dat_dsmm$time_to_AD[dat_dsmm$AD_conv == 1]
## double convertors (time to MCI)
dat_dsmm$t_event[dat_dsmm$double_conv == 1] = dat_dsmm$time_to_MCI[dat_dsmm$double_conv == 1]

# derive the age at event
dat_dsmm$age_event = dat_dsmm$AD_age
## MCI convertors: age at MCI conv
dat_dsmm$age_event[dat_dsmm$MCI_conv == 1] = dat_dsmm$MCI_age[dat_dsmm$MCI_conv == 1]
## AD convertors: age at AD conv
dat_dsmm$age_event[dat_dsmm$AD_conv == 1] = dat_dsmm$AD_age[dat_dsmm$AD_conv == 1]
## double convertors: age at MCI conv
dat_dsmm$age_event[dat_dsmm$double_conv == 1] = dat_dsmm$MCI_age[dat_dsmm$double_conv == 1]

# re-define gender - binary variable
dat_dsmm$gender = ifelse(dat_dsmm$Sex == "Male", 1, 0)

# centering age at MCI conversion at 77 (the median MCI age in the sample)
dat_dsmm$age_event77 = dat_dsmm$age_event - 77

# Race
dat_dsmm$Race %<>% factor(levels = c("Non-Hispanic White", "Non-Hispanic Black", "Other"))


# note: change the I_MCI to 0 for those with both intial MCI and AD onsets, but with missing APOE carrier status, in order to prevent them from being included in the estimation of model D and, therefore, excluded from automatically by the R function due to missingness.
dat_dsmm$I_MCI[is.na(dat_dsmm$apoe4pos) & dat_dsmm$dx_seq == "NC-MCI-AD"] = 0


# input missing values for `apoe4pos` and `gender` for subjects with I_MCI = 0
dat_dsmm$apoe4pos[is.na(dat_dsmm$apoe4pos) & dat_dsmm$I_MCI == 0] = 0.5
dat_dsmm$gender[is.na(dat_dsmm$gender) & dat_dsmm$I_MCI == 0] = 0.5


# Define DSMM (Sigmoid) functions

beta_smm = summary(smm_fit)$fixed %>% round(2) %>% suppressWarnings()

prior_spec <- eval(parse(text = paste0(
  "prior(normal(", beta_smm["theta0_Intercept", "Estimate"], ",", beta_smm["theta0_Intercept", "Est.Error"], "), nlpar = 'theta0') +  
  prior(normal(", beta_smm["theta1_Intercept", "Estimate"], ",",  beta_smm["theta1_Intercept", "Est.Error"], "), nlpar = 'theta1') + 
  prior(normal(", beta_smm["tau_Intercept", "Estimate"], ",", beta_smm["tau_Intercept", "Est.Error"], "), nlpar = 'tau') + 
  prior(normal(0, 1), nlpar = 'logD')"
)
))

# prior_spec <- prior(normal(0, 1), nlpar = "theta0") +
#               prior(normal(0, 1), nlpar = "theta1") +
#               prior(normal(0, 1), nlpar = "tau") +
#               prior(normal(0, 1), nlpar = "logD")
time0 = Sys.time()

set.seed(2024)
dsmm_fit <- brm(bf( eval(parse(text = paste0(outcome, " ~ theta0 - theta1/( 1 + exp( tau - (t_event - I_MCI * exp(logD) )))"))) , 
                    theta0 ~ apoe4pos + gender + Race + (1||Study/subj_id),
                    theta1 ~ apoe4pos + gender + Race + (1||Study/subj_id),
                    tau ~ apoe4pos + gender + Race + (1||Study/subj_id),
                    logD ~ apoe4pos + gender + ns(age_event77, 3) + apoe4pos:gender + apoe4pos:ns(age_event77, 3) + (1||Study/subj_id),
                    nl = TRUE),
                data = dat_dsmm, 
                prior = prior_spec,
                chains = 1,
                thin = 5,
                iter = n_iter,
                save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
                # , silent = 2, refresh = 0
)

saveRDS(dsmm_fit, paste0("objects/overall/subgroup_", outcome, "_dsmm_iter", n_iter, ".rds"))


time1 = Sys.time()

t_elapse = time1 - time0
print(t_elapse)

```

### Temporal orders
```{r, fig.width= 8, fig.height = 4}
t = seq(-8, 4, by = 0.1)
gender = 0:1
apoe = 0:1
race = c("White", "Other")

sig_mod <- function(t_AD, theta_0, theta_1, mid_time) {
    theta_0 - theta_1/( 1 + exp( mid_time - t_AD ) )
}
  
plot_data = list()

for (outcome in c("MEM", "LAN", "EXF")){
  
  obj = file.path("objects", "overall", list.files(path = "objects/overall", pattern = paste0("subgroup_binary_race", outcome, "_dsmm"))) %>% readRDS()

  # expected outcome value
  beta = summary(obj)$fixed
  beta_theta0 = lapply(strsplit(rownames(beta), "_"), FUN = function(x) x[1] == "theta0") %>% unlist
  beta_theta1 = lapply(strsplit(rownames(beta), "_"), FUN = function(x) x[1] == "theta1") %>% unlist
  beta_tau = lapply(strsplit(rownames(beta), "_"), FUN = function(x) x[1] == "tau") %>% unlist
  
  beta_theta0_hat = beta$Estimate[beta_theta0] %>% c()
  beta_theta1_hat =  beta$Estimate[beta_theta1] %>% c()
  beta_tau_hat = beta$Estimate[beta_tau] %>% c()
  
  # design matrix
  dat_X = expand.grid(int = 1, apoe = apoe, gender = gender, race = race)
  dat_X$race_other = ifelse(dat_X$race == "Other", 1, 0)
  X = dat_X[, -4]
  X %<>% as.matrix()
  
  dat_X$theta0_hat = X %*% beta_theta0_hat %>% c()
  dat_X$theta1_hat = X %*% beta_theta1_hat %>% c()
  dat_X$tau_hat = X %*% beta_tau_hat %>% c()
  
  # use bootstrapping to derive the confidence band
  i = 1
  out = list()
  nboot = 1000
  for (i in 1:nrow(dat_X)){
    temp_X = X[i, ] %>% matrix(nrow = 1)
    big_X = Matrix::bdiag(c(X[i, ]), c(X[i, ]), c(X[i, ])) %>% as.matrix %>% t()
    Sigma = big_X %*% vcov(obj)[1:ncol(big_X), 1:ncol(big_X)] %*% t(big_X)
    boot_curves = MASS::mvrnorm(n = nboot, mu = c(dat_X$theta0_hat[i], dat_X$theta1_hat[i], dat_X$tau_hat[i]), Sigma = Sigma)
    boot_val = lapply(1:nboot, function(x){
                     # bootstrapped theta0
                     b0 = boot_curves[x, 1]
                     # bootstrapped theta1
                     b1 = boot_curves[x, 2]
                     # bootstrapped tau
                     b2 = boot_curves[x, 3]
                     boot_y = lapply(t, FUN = function(a) {sig_mod(a, theta_0 = b0, theta_1 = b1, mid_time = b2)}) %>% unlist
                     return(boot_y)
                    })
    boot_val = do.call(cbind, boot_val)
    boot_CI = apply(boot_val, 1, FUN = function(x){ quantile(x, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)) })
    boot_CI = t(boot_CI) %>% as.data.frame()
    colnames(boot_CI) = c("ll", "ul")
    boot_CI = cbind(t, boot_CI)
    boot_res = merge(dat_X[i, ] %>% as.data.frame(), boot_CI, by=character(0))
    boot_res$Ey = sig_mod(t_AD = boot_res$t, 
                       theta_0 = boot_res$theta0_hat,
                       theta_1 =  boot_res$theta1_hat,
                       mid_time =  boot_res$tau_hat
                       )
    out[[i]] = boot_res
  }
  
  out = do.call(rbind, out)
  
  out$outcome = outcome
  plot_data[[outcome]] = out
}

plot_data = do.call(rbind, plot_data)

plot_data$apoe %<>% factor(levels = 0:1, labels = c("Non-carrier", "Carrier"))
plot_data$gender %<>% factor(levels = 0:1, labels = c("Female", "Male"))
plot_data$Marker = factor(plot_data$outcome, levels = c("MEM", "LAN", "EXF"), labels = c("Memory", "Language", "Executive function"))
```

```{r, fig.width= 12, fig.height = 6}
library(ggh4x) # for nested facet labels

plot_data$race_label = plot_data$race
plot_data$race_label %<>% factor(labels = c("Race: White", "Race: non-White"))
 
plot_data$apoe_label = plot_data$apoe
plot_data$apoe_label %<>% factor(labels = c("APOE-e4: non-carrier", "APOE-e4: carrier"))
 
# the code for figure 3 needs to be run first.
P = ggplot() + 
  geom_line(data = plot_data, aes(x = t, y = Ey, color = Marker), linewidth = 1) + 
  geom_ribbon(data = plot_data, aes(x = t, ymin = ll, ymax = ul, fill = Marker), alpha = 0.1) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-6, 4, by = 2)) + # adding more tick marks
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) + 
  facet_nested(race_label ~ apoe_label + gender ) + 
  labs(title = "With main effects", y = "Harmonized cognitive measure", x = "Time to AD diagnosis", fill = "Cognitive domain", color = "Cognitive domain")

P
```

### Temporal orders
```{r, fig.width= 8, fig.height = 4}
t = seq(-8, 4, by = 0.1)
gender = 0:1
apoe = 0:1
race = c("White", "Other")

sig_mod <- function(t_AD, theta_0, theta_1, mid_time) {
    theta_0 - theta_1/( 1 + exp( mid_time - t_AD ) )
}
  
plot_data = list()

for (outcome in c("MEM", "LAN", "EXF")){
  
  obj = file.path("objects", "overall", list.files(path = "objects/overall", pattern = paste0("interaction_subgroup_", outcome, "_dsmm"))) %>% readRDS()

  # expected outcome value
  beta = summary(obj)$fixed
  beta_theta0 = lapply(strsplit(rownames(beta), "_"), FUN = function(x) x[1] == "theta0") %>% unlist
  beta_theta1 = lapply(strsplit(rownames(beta), "_"), FUN = function(x) x[1] == "theta1") %>% unlist
  beta_tau = lapply(strsplit(rownames(beta), "_"), FUN = function(x) x[1] == "tau") %>% unlist
  
  beta_theta0_hat = beta$Estimate[beta_theta0] %>% c()
  beta_theta1_hat =  beta$Estimate[beta_theta1] %>% c()
  beta_tau_hat = beta$Estimate[beta_tau] %>% c()
  
  # design matrix
  dat_X = expand.grid(int = 1, apoe = apoe, gender = gender, race = race)
  dat_X$race_other = ifelse(dat_X$race == "Other", 1, 0)
  X = dat_X[, -4]
  X$apoeXgender = X$apoe * X$gender 
  X$apoeXrace = X$apoe * X$race_other
  X$genderXrace = X$gender * X$race_other
  X %<>% as.matrix()
  
  dat_X$theta0_hat = X %*% beta_theta0_hat %>% c()
  dat_X$theta1_hat = X %*% beta_theta1_hat %>% c()
  dat_X$tau_hat = X %*% beta_tau_hat %>% c()
  
  # use bootstrapping to derive the confidence band
  i = 1
  out = list()
  nboot = 1000
  for (i in 1:nrow(dat_X)){
    temp_X = X[i, ] %>% matrix(nrow = 1)
    big_X = Matrix::bdiag(c(X[i, ]), c(X[i, ]), c(X[i, ])) %>% as.matrix %>% t()
    Sigma = big_X %*% vcov(obj)[1:ncol(big_X), 1:ncol(big_X)] %*% t(big_X)
    boot_curves = MASS::mvrnorm(n = nboot, mu = c(dat_X$theta0_hat[i], dat_X$theta1_hat[i], dat_X$tau_hat[i]), Sigma = Sigma)
    boot_val = lapply(1:nboot, function(x){
                     # bootstrapped theta0
                     b0 = boot_curves[x, 1]
                     # bootstrapped theta1
                     b1 = boot_curves[x, 2]
                     # bootstrapped tau
                     b2 = boot_curves[x, 3]
                     boot_y = lapply(t, FUN = function(a) {sig_mod(a, theta_0 = b0, theta_1 = b1, mid_time = b2)}) %>% unlist
                     return(boot_y)
                    })
    boot_val = do.call(cbind, boot_val)
    boot_CI = apply(boot_val, 1, FUN = function(x){ quantile(x, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)) })
    boot_CI = t(boot_CI) %>% as.data.frame()
    colnames(boot_CI) = c("ll", "ul")
    boot_CI = cbind(t, boot_CI)
    boot_res = merge(dat_X[i, ] %>% as.data.frame(), boot_CI, by=character(0))
    boot_res$Ey = sig_mod(t_AD = boot_res$t,
                       theta_0 = boot_res$theta0_hat,
                       theta_1 =  boot_res$theta1_hat,
                       mid_time =  boot_res$tau_hat
                       )
    out[[i]] = boot_res
  }

  out = do.call(rbind, out)
  
  out$outcome = outcome
  plot_data[[outcome]] = out
}

plot_data = do.call(rbind, plot_data)

plot_data$apoe %<>% factor(levels = 0:1, labels = c("Non-carrier", "Carrier"))
plot_data$gender %<>% factor(levels = 0:1, labels = c("Female", "Male"))
plot_data$Marker = factor(plot_data$outcome, levels = c("MEM", "LAN", "EXF"), labels = c("Memory", "Language", "Executive function"))
```
